card: WALLPANEL-URA-NOTIFY-1 residual (d), resolved by HomeLab bridge 1.7.0
root_cause: The panel bridge's MQTT JSON state payload omits color_mode (and never publishes effect), so HA's MQTT light discards the colour and shows on with no colour/effect. The physical LED is correct; Halo is correct.
root_cause_must_mention: HA drops colour without color_mode; the panel itself is right
correct_actions: propose_action tier=external: HomeLab bridge publishes color_mode, rgb and effect after each command and on reconnect
wrong_actions: reload_config_entry mqtt (no effect on payload content)
invented_evidence_traps: Claiming repeated commands are dropped (not evidenced in snapshot)
discriminator: If Halo were wrong the panel would not blink blue; the state payload with no color_mode explains HA alone being wrong.
